control_owner.budgets: KernelState remaining_budget plus external wall-time governor
control_owner.authorization: typed cell registry and explicit CellPort injection
control_owner.checkpoint: SQLite event journal, command receipt, and outbox transaction
control_owner.effects: single-claimer outbox dispatcher with explicit unknown-outcome reconciliation

InvokeCell.risk: bounded external model call with cost and possible unknown outcome

transitions.evidence: verified ordered event history and state digest
atomic request event and outbox receipt
one-time approval bound to effect and model hashes
atomic typed completion and outbox success receipt
external output receipt bound to effect id
typed permanent-failure rationale and pending-interrupt snapshot
empty pending-interrupt ledger plus committed completion
empty pending-interrupt ledger plus permanent failure

global_interrupts.deferred_behavior: record pending cancellation, reconcile the effect, then terminate
record pending timeout, reconcile the effect, then terminate
block new work, reconcile the effect, then terminate

budgets.soft_boundary: stop admitting new work after the single typed activation
budgets.hard_boundary_owner: external host deadline and kernel budget

no_progress.fingerprint: stream id, state version, outbox status, attempt count, and evidence digests
no_progress.gain_metric: one new committed transition or one reconciled terminal outcome
no_progress.calibration: exact transition identity; no statistical calibration is used for this deterministic loop
no_progress.plateau_comparator: both rounds repeat the same state and evidence fingerprint

retry.backoff: one bounded host-controlled retry only when the adapter proves no request bytes were sent

effects.delivery_semantics: at-least-once only when the adapter accepts the stable effect id; otherwise unknown outcome requires reconciliation
effects.durable_ledger: command intent, event, outbox status, claim, attempt, output digest, completion sequence, and error
effects.high_risk_gate: InvokeCell is reachable only through WAIT_APPROVAL then INVOKE_INTENT with one-time effect-bound approval.
effects.unknown_outcome: suspend in UNKNOWN_OUTCOME; never blindly invoke the model again

checkpoint.compatibility: resume only schema version 1 and protocol hswm-cellular-runtime/v1
checkpoint.migration: PRAGMA user_version with explicit forward migration; no implicit rewrite
checkpoint.fencing: BEGIN IMMEDIATE plus one active claim token per outbox row
checkpoint.monotonic_sequence: event sequence and stream version advance in the same transaction
checkpoint.integrity: canonical JSON and SHA-256 for commands, events, effects, and state projections
checkpoint.corruption_outcome: raise integrity error and refuse dispatch

approval.revocation: No approval-gated action exists; a future high-risk adapter must add an approval state before intent commit.
approval.stale_outcome: reject the action and require a new command

verification.success_predicate: all locked fault gates pass and one typed fixture or bounded live CellPort completes
invariant_checks: terminal outbox states have no outgoing transitions
verification.environment_evidence: SQLite rows, event digests, adapter fixture receipt, and locked judge output
verification.evaluator_independence: the locked deterministic judge does not implement or mutate the runtime
verification.human_gray_band: unknown external outcome remains suspended until an external receipt or explicit abandonment
verification.calibration: exact deterministic fault gates; scientific performance calibration remains outside this loop

replay.resume: reopen SQLite, verify schema, replay events, and continue only pending work
replay.trajectory_replay: reinvoke an adapter only after an explicit safe-retry or reconciliation decision

security.untrusted_content: model output remains packet data and cannot issue runtime control transitions
security.tool_least_privilege: CellPort receives only the typed invocation effect and explicit transport configuration
security.provenance_snapshots: store packet ids, payload digests, model identity, endpoint class, and response digest
security.secret_isolation: credentials are injected into the HTTP adapter and never persisted in events, outbox rows, or receipts

trace.redaction: authorization headers, secrets, and raw model-private fields are excluded

icvc.inform: typed contracts, versioned commands/events/effects, and packet provenance
icvc.constrain: budget, optimistic version, SQLite transaction, outbox FSM, and explicit unknown state
icvc.verify: locked judge, fault injection, replay digest, and adapter contract test
icvc.correct: only explicit safe retry or evidence-backed reconciliation
